_comment: Shops whose scraped logo candidate was rejected on visual inspection: a generic site-template/CMS icon, an unreadable crop, or an image that isn't actually the shop's own logo. This file is HAND-MAINTAINED, not generated -- unlike logos.json. Deleting the .webp file alone does NOT stick: scripts/scrape-logos.py rewrites logos.json from whatever is on disk, so the exact same bad image gets re-downloaded and silently re-added the next time the script runs, unless the rejection is also recorded here. Each entry is keyed on BOTH slug and the exact source URL the script fetched, not slug alone: if a shop later uploads a real logo at a different URL (a new filename, a redesigned site), it re-surfaces for review instead of being locked out forever. Add a row here whenever a scraped logo is rejected by eye.
